name: Assailant
source:
"...I think I'm just going to kill you all."

A member of the organization known as Idea. Specializing in martial arts, they care for nothing other than brutally and mercilessly crushing their foes.

[Taken from [url=http://aksysgames.com/code-realize/]the official website[/url]]

Age: Unknown

[spoiler]Her true identity is Guinevere, former queen consort of King Arthur Pendragon.[/spoiler]
